label: naming:judge
prompt:
Rate how well each proposed slash-command name fits its task, from 1 (misleading or meaningless) to 5 (exactly what a developer would type). Each task has two names, A and B.

- f001: task="Push the current feature branch and open a pull request against main with a filled-out description linking the related issue and requesting reviewers." A=/open-pr B=/open-push
- f002: task="Rebase the current feature branch onto the latest base branch and resolve any merge conflicts that come up." A=/rebase-branch B=/rebase-conflicts
- f003: task="Cherry-pick a specific hotfix commit from main onto a release branch and push it so it can be deployed." A=/git-push B=/cherry-pick-hotfix
- f004: task="Address reviewer comments on an open pull request by making the requested code changes, pushing an update, and replying to the review thread." A=/address-review B=/review-push
- f006: task="Create a new release branch off main, bump the version, tag it, and publish a draft GitHub release." A=/cut-main B=/cut-release
- f007: task="Assign reviewers to an open pull request based on CODEOWNERS and ping the relevant team to request review." A=/review-reviewers B=/assign-reviewers
- f010: task="Build the package and publish it to a package registry like PyPI or npm." A=/build-pypi B=/publish-package
- f011: task="Build release binaries and create a GitHub release with generated notes and attached artifacts." A=/tag-release-github B=/create-github-release
- f012: task="Create a new release branch off main for the upcoming release cycle and register the version with tracking tools." A=/cut-release-branch B=/cut-main-release
- f013: task="Bump the iOS build number and push a new build through fastlane to a TestFlight group for internal testing." A=/testflight-build B=/build-testflight
- f014: task="Cherry-pick a fix that merged into main back onto an older maintained release branch and tag a patch release." A=/git-tag B=/backport-fix
- f015: task="Investigate a flaky test by rerunning it repeatedly to reproduce the failure, then fix the underlying race/timing issue." A=/fix-flaky-test B=/git-commit
- f016: task="Re-trigger the failed CI job(s) for a pull request on GitHub Actions without pushing a new commit, after confirming the failure isn't code-related." A=/rerun-failed B=/rerun-ci
- f017: task="Generate a test coverage report for a module, identify undercovered files/lines, and add or suggest tests to close the gap to the target threshold." A=/pytest B=/improve-coverage
- f020: task="Use git bisect across recent commits to find which change broke a previously passing test." A=/bisect-regression B=/test-find-bisect
- f025: task="Build a new version, deploy it as a canary alongside the stable production release, and watch metrics before full rollout." A=/tag-canary B=/canary-deploy
- f026: task="Apply pending database schema migrations to an environment as part of a service release, backing up the database first." A=/post-staging B=/run-migration
- f027: task="Run smoke tests and health checks against an environment right after a deploy to confirm the release is healthy." A=/smoke-test B=/run-staging
- f029: task="Autogenerate a new alembic migration from current SQLAlchemy models, review it, and apply it to the local dev database." A=/generate-migration B=/alembic
- f030: task="Run pending database migrations against a specific deployed environment (staging/prod) as part of a release." A=/psql B=/run-migrations
- f032: task="Reset the local development database and load it with seed/fixture data for development or demo purposes." A=/reset-db B=/psql
- f033: task="Write and run a batched data-migration script that backfills a new or changed column on existing rows in a table." A=/backfill-column B=/psql
- f037: task="Take a crash report/stack trace from a crash reporting tool and reproduce the crash locally to confirm the root cause." A=/reproduce-crash B=/add-repro
- f038: task="Profile a slow API endpoint under load to identify the bottleneck causing high latency." A=/profile-endpoint B=/ab
- f039: task="Investigate a pod that was OOMKilled to determine what caused the memory spike." A=/kubectl-logs B=/investigate-oom
- f041: task="Investigate a sudden spike of a specific error in Sentry and identify the root cause and offending code/release." A=/investigate-errors B=/check-sentry
- f042: task="Pull the database slow query log/pg_stat_statements to identify which query is consuming the most time and trace it back to the code that issues it." A=/check-slow-query B=/find-slow-query
- f043: task="Generate API reference documentation (OpenAPI spec update plus a markdown doc page) for a new or changed REST endpoint." A=/document-endpoint B=/update-openapi
- f045: task="Update the README and CHANGELOG to reflect a new version release, including new features, breaking changes, and upgrade instructions." A=/update-changelog B=/update-changelog
- f046: task="Add or update docstrings for public functions and classes in a module following the project's documentation style." A=/add-docstrings B=/add-docstrings
- f047: task="Regenerate a terraform module's README with terraform-docs so the variables/outputs tables match the current code." A=/add-readme B=/update-tf-docs
- f048: task="Update the configuration reference doc listing all environment variables, defaults, and descriptions for a service." A=/update-env-docs B=/add-env
- f050: task="Query the warehouse for this week's key metrics and produce the recurring weekly summary report, then share it with the team." A=/report-weekly B=/weekly-report
- f051: task="Audit a dataset or table for data quality issues (nulls, duplicates, outliers) and produce a short summary before it's used downstream." A=/audit-data-quality B=/check-data
- f053: task="Write an ad-hoc SQL query to answer a stakeholder's specific question and export the results to a CSV for them." A=/export-query B=/export-csv
- f054: task="Analyze an A/B test's results from the experiment assignment and event tables, compute lift and statistical significance for the primary metric, and write a readout summary." A=/test-readout B=/analyze-ab-test
- f056: task="After running a backfill or reprocessing job for a data pipeline, validate that output row counts and key aggregates match expectations between the source and target tables." A=/check-backfill B=/validate-backfill
- f057: task="Rotate a database credential in AWS Secrets Manager and restart the dependent k8s deployment so it picks up the new value." A=/rotate-secret B=/rotate-restart
- f058: task="Run terraform plan and apply for a given module/environment and post the plan output on the related PR." A=/add-plan-workspace B=/terraform-apply
- f059: task="Investigate a CrashLoopBackOff pod in a namespace by checking status, logs, and events, then restart the deployment once the cause is understood." A=/fix-crashloop B=/rollout-logs
- f060: task="Build a new Docker image, push it to the registry, and update the Helm values/manifest so the environment deploys the new tag." A=/deploy-image B=/build-push
- f062: task="Bump a service's Helm chart/image version, update per-environment values files, and roll out the upgrade." A=/update-chart B=/bump-helm-release
- f065: task="Perform a security-focused review of a pull request's diff, looking for injection, auth, and secrets issues before approving." A=/security-review-pr B=/review-security
- f068: task="Check out an open PR, diagnose why its CI checks are failing, and push a fix until the checks pass." A=/fix-failing B=/fix-pr-ci
- f069: task="Review an open pull request that adds a database migration, checking for unsafe operations like long locks, missing reversibility, and backward incompatibility, then leave review feedback." A=/gh-pr-diff B=/review-migration
- f072: task="Patch a vulnerable Python dependency flagged by a security scan and verify the fix with tests." A=/patch-vulnerability B=/sync-cryptography
- f074: task="Update Go module dependencies to their latest minor/patch versions and regenerate go.sum." A=/go-mod B=/update-go-deps
- f075: task="Bump a Docker base image to a patched tag that remediates a reported CVE, rebuild the image, and verify with a vulnerability scan." A=/build-base-image B=/bump-base-image
- f077: task="Align a shared crate to one consistent version across all members of a Cargo workspace and regenerate Cargo.lock accordingly." A=/update-reqwest B=/align-crate-version
- f078: task="Scaffold a new CRUD REST endpoint (route, controller, service, validation, tests) in the existing Node/Express API following the established pattern." A=/test-endpoint B=/scaffold-endpoint
- f079: task="Scaffold a brand new Python microservice skeleton (pyproject, Dockerfile, health check, CI pipeline) inside the monorepo." A=/scaffold-microservice B=/sync-fraud-detector
- f081: task="Scaffold a new subcommand for the internal Go CLI tool, including command file, flag parsing, help text, and tests." A=/build-subcommand B=/scaffold-subcommand
- f083: task="Scaffold a new background job/queue consumer with a handler, retry config, tests, and registration in the job runner." A=/scaffold-worker B=/test-job
- f084: task="Scaffold a new reusable Terraform module with main/variables/outputs/README and wire it into an environment's root config." A=/validate-module B=/scaffold-tf-module
- f085: task="Bump the iOS app version/build number, build with fastlane, and upload the new build to TestFlight." A=/release-testflight B=/release-testflight
- f087: task="Diagnose and fix an iOS code signing / provisioning profile error so the app builds and archives successfully." A=/fix-code-signing B=/fix-signing
- f090: task="Generate and frame localized App Store screenshots across devices using fastlane snapshot and frameit." A=/post-app-screenshots B=/capture-screenshots
- f091: task="Bump the iOS and Android version/build numbers, cut a release branch, and open a PR for a new app release." A=/bump-build B=/cut-app-release
- f096: task="Pick up an assigned Jira ticket, create a correctly-named feature branch, transition the ticket to In Progress, and announce the kickoff in the team Slack channel." A=/start-jira-ticket B=/git-fetch
- f097: task="Read a Notion project spec and break it down into a Linear epic with linked child sub-issues for engineering to pick up." A=/create-notion-linear B=/spec-to-linear

Reply with ONLY JSON: {"ratings": {"<family_id>": {"A": <1-5>, "B": <1-5>}, ...}}
